pins.head: A LID ENDS THE PILE
pins.title: Small Apartment: A Lidded Basket Hides What an Open Bin Puts on Display
pins.desc: An open basket beside the sofa fills up and then shows everything in it. The same basket with a lid holds the same things and reads as furniture, which matters in a room where the storage and the living space are the same square metres. Contains affiliate links. #SmallApartment #LivingRoomStorage #BudgetHome
pins.alt: A large lidded wicker basket and a fabric storage ottoman beside a pale sofa, with a ladder bookcase of books and woven baskets behind.

pins.head: OUT OF THE BAG, ON THE SHELF
pins.sub: A Pack You Can Actually See
pins.title: Acne Patches: The Pack You Can See Is the One That Gets Used
pins.desc: A box of patches in a drawer under the sink gets remembered about two days late. Keep the sheet on the shelf by the mirror, in a small dish if the packaging annoys you, and the patch goes on the night it would actually do something. Contains affiliate links. #AcnePatches #SkincareStorage #EveningRoutine
pins.alt: A sheet of small clear hydrocolloid patches and a cream ceramic dish on a white bathroom counter by a bright window, with folded towels on the shelf behind.

pins.head: ROLL THEM, DO NOT FOLD
pins.title: Small Bathroom: Rolled Towels Fit an Over-Toilet Shelf Better Than Folded
pins.desc: Folded towels stack to the shelf above and then you can only take the top one. Rolled, they sit in a row you can pull from anywhere, they use the depth of the shelf instead of its height, and a narrow over-toilet unit suddenly holds the whole set. Contains affiliate links. #BathroomStorage #TowelStorage #SmallBathroom
pins.alt: A white shelf unit over a toilet holding woven baskets and rolled white towels, with a teal towel on a hook beside a glass shower screen.

pins.head: LEFTOVER VINYL IS WASTE
pins.title: Adhesive Vinyl: Work Out How Many Decals a Roll Gives Before You Buy
pins.desc: Rolls are sold in feet, projects are counted in decals, and the gap between the two is the offcut you throw away. Divide the roll width by your decal width, do the same down the length, and you know whether one roll covers the batch or leaves you two short. Contains affiliate links. #VinylCrafts #CraftPlanning #CricutProjects
pins.alt: Two rolls of adhesive vinyl in sage and cream lying on a wooden worktable beside a gridded cutting mat, a calculator and a pencil.

pins.head: MARKED CUPS BEAT GUESSING
pins.title: Silicone Measuring Cups and Stir Sticks for Mixing Resin by Ratio
pins.desc: Resin cures on a ratio, and a kitchen cup with no marks on it turns that ratio into a guess. Graduated silicone cups show both parts as you pour, and cured resin peels straight out of the silicone afterwards, so the same cups come back for the next pour. Contains affiliate links. #EpoxyResin #ResinSupplies #CraftTools
pins.alt: Clear graduated measuring cups and two white resin bottles on a black silicone work mat, with wooden stir sticks in a jar and blue nitrile gloves beside them.

pins.head: PAPER ON EDGE, NOT FLAT
pins.title: Small Home Office: An Upright Sorter Beats a Flat Pile of Paper
pins.desc: Paper stacked flat gets filed by accident, oldest at the bottom, and the thing you need is always three sheets down. A sorter stands the same paper on edge where every item has a visible spine, and the desk gets back the footprint the pile was using. Contains affiliate links. #HomeOffice #PaperOrganization #DeskSetup
pins.alt: An upright file sorter holding papers and a small drawer box of pens on a light wood desk beside a laptop on a wooden stand.

pins.head: HAIRS UP WHEN THEY DRY
pins.title: Paint Brushes: Dry Them Bristles Up So Water Leaves the Ferrule
pins.desc: Water that sits in the metal ferrule swells the glue and the hairs start shedding a few sessions later. Shake the brush out and stand it hairs upward in a block so gravity pulls the water down and away, never bristles down in a jar overnight. Contains affiliate links. #BrushCare #AcrylicPainting #StudioHabits
pins.alt: A wooden block holder with paint brushes standing bristles up, a clear glass jar and a folded grey cloth on a wooden table by a window.

pins.head: A HANGER STRETCHES WOOL
pins.title: Tiny Closet: Fold Knitwear Into Hanging Shelves Instead of Hanging It
pins.desc: A heavy jumper on a hanger stretches at the shoulders and never recovers. A hanging shelf organizer takes the same jumpers folded, uses rail space the clothes beside them were not using, and comes down with the rail when you move out. Contains affiliate links. #ClosetOrganization #KnitwearCare #RenterFriendly
pins.alt: A fabric hanging shelf organizer holding folded knitwear inside a narrow closet, with clothes on a rail beside it and clear shoe boxes on the floor.

pins.head: A GLASS JAR REMINDS YOU
pins.title: Laundry Pods: A Clear Jar Tells You to Reorder Before You Run Out
pins.desc: Pods live in an opaque tub, so the first sign you are low is the day there are none. Tip them into a clear jar on the shelf and the level is the reminder, visible from across the room every time you walk past with a basket. Contains affiliate links. #LaundryRoom #RefillPlanning #HouseholdTips
pins.alt: A white detergent jug, a small open box of powder with a scoop and a glass jar of laundry pods with a cork lid on a light wood shelf beside folded towels.

pins.head: THE SEAT IS ALSO A BOX
pins.title: Renter Storage: A Storage Ottoman Is a Seat and a Box in One Footprint
pins.desc: A rented room rarely has space for both an extra seat and an extra cupboard. An ottoman that opens is both, it needs no fixing to anything, and the things you least want on display are the ones that go inside it. Contains affiliate links. #RenterFriendly #HiddenStorage #SmallLivingRoom
pins.alt: A pale sofa with teal and terracotta cushions and a long fabric ottoman with a teal throw in a bright living room, with a shelf of plants beside the window.

pins.head: A SMALL BAG TO TEST A ROAST
pins.title: A 12 oz Whole-Bean House Blend: Small Enough to Try Before You Commit
pins.desc: A two-pound bag of a roast you turn out not to like is six weeks of drinking it anyway. A 12 oz bag is enough mornings to be sure and little enough to stay fresh to the last scoop, which is the right size for trying something new. Contains affiliate links. #WholeBeanCoffee #CoffeeAtHome #PantryPlanning
pins.alt: A plain kraft coffee bag on a light wood kitchen counter beside a pile of assorted coffee pods, a calculator and a notepad.

pins.head: THE LINER GOES IN FIRST
pins.title: Under the Sink: Lay a Waterproof Liner Down Before Any Bin Goes In
pins.desc: The cabinet under a sink fails from a slow drip nobody sees for a month. A waterproof liner across the base catches it, shows you the puddle while it is still small, and lifts out to be wiped instead of the chipboard swelling. Fit it before the bins, not after. Contains affiliate links. #UnderSinkStorage #KitchenOrganization #CleaningSupplies
pins.alt: An open teal sink cabinet with the drain pipe in the middle and two cream bins of cleaning bottles on a waterproof liner either side of it.
